commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A cross from Koni De Winter (AC Milan) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+3' Mike Maignan makes a good save! Jesus Rodriguez (Como) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Smolcic (Como) comes onto the pitch for Mergim Vojvoda.
87' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
87' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and makes a call. Free kick. Como will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
87' Martin Baturina (Como) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

87' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.
85' Rough tackle by Anastasios Douvikas (Como). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Jean Butez stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
83' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafael Leao trots off the pitch and is replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
80' A card of the red variety is shown to Massimiliano Allegri (AC Milan). He has been sent off.
80' Martin Baturina (Como) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires in from the penalty spot, but his effort zooms just past the right post.
78' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Da Cunha (Como) replacing Sergi Roberto.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jesus Rodriguez (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
78' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

76' A decent save by Mike Maignan. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
75' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Rafael Leao (AC Milan) heads on.
75' The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Nico Paz will be replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).
71' It's time for a substitution. Alex Valle (Como) comes on in place of Ignace Van der Brempt.
70' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Matteo Gabbia just over the bar.
68' Sergi Roberto (Como) is punished with the yellow card.
68' A yellow-coloured card is received by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
68' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives the ball on the edge of the box and lobs the goalkeeper, who was off his line. He makes it 1:1.
63' Jean Butez (Como) gets a yellow card.
63' One of the players from AC Milan times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
62' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Christopher Nkunku and he is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:4.
58' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luka Modric (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
56' Substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) on for Zachary Athekame.
55' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Samuele Ricci is replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
55' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

54' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
53' Today's referee Maurizio Mariani rightly decides to book Nico Paz (Como) for his harsh tackle.
52' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Martin Baturina (Como) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to AC Milan.
51' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
51' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Now AC Milan have a corner.

50' That didn't go as planned! Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Jean Butez, who easily kept it out.
49' The foul by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) was seen by Maurizio Mariani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
49' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings it in and Rafael Leao gets on the end of it, but Jean Butez shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
47' Nico Paz (Como) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
46' Substitution. Strahinja Pavlovic makes way for Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
43' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Maurizio Mariani no option but to blow his whistle.
42' Nico Paz (Como) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
40' Martin Baturina (Como) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
39' Sergi Roberto (Como) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Mike Maignan. Como get a corner.
39' There's an opportunity for Martin Baturina (Como) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
38' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Como have a free kick.
37' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
36' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sergi Roberto (Como).
34' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

34' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Jean Butez, who makes a glorious save! AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
32' 0 - 1 GOAL! Nico Paz (Como) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
31' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
30' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

30' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jean Butez anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the right side of the target.
26' Goal, no wait, Como have a goal disallowed due to a foul.
25' The ball possession at the moment is 30:70.
23' Martin Baturina (Como) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
21' Martin Baturina (Como) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mike Maignan is quickest to intercept the ball.
20' Nico Paz (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Maurizio Mariani who sees an offensive foul.
19' Como are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
15' Maxence Caqueret (Como) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
14' Jacobo Ramon (Como) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ignace Van der Brempt, but Mike Maignan displays great awareness to stop him.
13' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
11' A player from AC Milan commits a rough challenge. Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
8' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
6' The corner from Nico Paz (Como) is cleared away by the defence.
5' An attempted cross from Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is cleared. Good work from Como as they win a corner.
4' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
3' AC Milan hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will supervise the game today.
